test_set.english: A term for: the entity that performs the evaluation is the same entity whose work is being evaluated, so a result marked as passing only establishes that the two agree with one another, and does not establish that the work is correct.
A term for: the party doing the grading is identical to the party being graded, so a pass merely shows the grader agrees with itself, and says nothing about whether the answer is actually right.
A term for: the checker and the checked are one and the same party, so a successful check certifies only self-consistency, never correctness against an independent reference.
A term for: the evaluator and the evaluated coincide, so a passing result demonstrates only that the evaluation matches its own expectations, not that it is true.
A term for: the scorer and the scored are the same, so a pass confirms only that the two sides agree with each other, and confirms nothing about external correctness.

manifest.method: tiktoken per-pair delta (ainglish - english), floor = worst (max) tokenizer mean; fresh disjoint English by Rosetta
